result.description: What the service returned, shaped by the ROS service. A service call is awaited to completion, so there is no job to observe afterwards and no id to hold on to.

result_omitted.description: Present when the service answered and the robot did not send the response because it was too large; `result` is `null` then. Absent otherwise.

reason.description: Why the result was left out. `too_large`: its frame would have exceeded the robot's frame limit.

bytes.description: The size of the result alone, serialised as JSON, in bytes.

limit_bytes.description: The frame limit the robot applied, in bytes (`BRIDGE_FRAME_MAX_BYTES`, 1.5 MiB).
